determines: Email syntax and domain mail routing
With deep=true, a mailbox deliverability observation
does_not_determine: A new mailbox probe on every request
required_context: deep=true only when a mailbox check is needed

freshness.effective_max_age_status: not_guaranteed; response-cache refreshes can retain a verdict beyond corpus reuse windows

valid.true: Syntax is valid; this does not establish mailbox existence

domain_valid.true: MX or permitted A/AAAA fallback supplies a mail route
domain_valid.false: When valid=true, no usable mail route, including an explicit null MX. When valid=false, routing was not checked

deep.deliverable.false: Negative verification, eligible local disposable/no-route rejection, or invalid syntax that skipped verification; check valid first
deep.deliverable.null: Mailbox check did not complete; no verification unit is charged

deep.catchall.true: Domain accepts all addresses; an individual mailbox is not established
deep.catchall.false: Not classified as catchall, including invalid input and local rejection where no mailbox probe ran

deep.empty_object: Requested with an app key; mailbox verification is locked

metered.name: email
metered.when: deep=true and a valid-syntax eligible check completes

billing.account_state: unknown; included balance, on-demand access, accepted rates and spend cap require account state

deep.secret_or_public: Uses available included verifications or enabled on-demand allowance, including on Free
deep.app: Locked; returns deep: {} without a verification

access.effective_access_status: not_checked; key fences, account access, quotas and spending controls still apply

retry.guidance: Do not infer a retry from null. Repeated completed deep checks consume additional verification units; a transport failure does not prove the previous attempt was unbilled. DNS failures can return 503 before mailbox verification.

determines: With entitled deep=true, available registration details
does_not_determine: Whether a registrar will sell an unregistered domain
A live registry query on every request
required_context: domain: a hostname rather than a URL or email address

available.null: No usable current registry observation; availability is unknown

deep.empty_object: Plan does not unlock registration details, or registration is unavailable

billing.account_state: unknown; pooled allowance and accepted account terms are not checked

deep.entitlement: Paid plan; app keys retain plan-deep access

access.effective_access_status: not_checked; key fences, account access and quotas still apply

retry.guidance: available=null is a completed HTTP response with an unknown fact, not evidence the domain is free. Do not retry automatically from null; respect rate and quota errors.

determines: Published answer records from a recursive DNS view
does_not_determine: Global propagation or a zone transfer
required_context: domain: a DNS name, including supported underscore or reverse names
type: one supported record type, or omit for all ten supported types

records.empty_array: Successful lookup with no answer records of the requested types
records.failure: A failed type returns an error, never an empty or silently partial result

Explicit null MX; this domain declines mail
records[].value.CNAME: Published alias; its target may not exist

http_status.503: Temporary DNS failure; no negative verdict

deep.empty_object: Requested; this product has no additional deep fields

billing.account_state: unknown; pooled allowance and accepted account terms are not checked

deep.entitlement: All records are core on every plan

access.effective_access_status: not_checked; key fences, account access and quotas still apply

retry.guidance: An empty records array and a DNS-name 404 are negative answers, not transient failures. Reuse records only within their remaining TTL; respect rate and quota errors.

determines: Published MX hosts sorted by priority and host
An explicit null MX that declines mail
does_not_determine: No mail route from an empty MX list alone
required_context: domain: a hostname rather than a URL or email address

freshness.actual_age_status: not_exposed; use dns with type=MX for remaining record TTLs

mx.empty_array: No MX records; A/AAAA mail fallback may still apply

http_status.503: Temporary DNS failure; no negative verdict

deep.omitted: This product has no deep response fields

billing.account_state: unknown; pooled allowance and accepted account terms are not checked

deep.entitlement: All MX records are core on every plan

access.effective_access_status: not_checked; key fences, account access and quotas still apply

retry.guidance: Do not retry solely because mx is empty. Use email for mail-route validation or dns for explicit A/AAAA records; respect rate and quota errors.

determines: Country reference information by ISO2, ISO3 or name
With entitled deep=true, geography, population and national reference attributes
does_not_determine: A live census or uniform observation date for every field
Tax due on a particular transaction
required_context: code: ISO2, ISO3 or a country name
deep=true for profile fields such as population and area

freshness.actual_age_status: not_exposed; population period describes that statistic only

name_local.null: Native name unavailable or identical to the original name before display translation

deep.population_period.null: Observation period is unknown; never infer it from an import date

deep.water_area.null: Unknown or inconsistent with the archived total

deep.tax.null: No national consumption levy is named; local levies may still apply

deep.tax_rate.null: Unavailable or no national levy applies

deep.empty_object: Requested but the plan does not unlock the profile

billing.account_state: unknown; pooled allowance and accepted account terms are not checked

deep.entitlement: Paid plan; app keys retain plan-deep access

access.effective_access_status: not_checked; key fences, account access and quotas still apply

retry.guidance: Do not retry to fill null reference fields or a locked deep object. Preserve unknowns and distinguish reported zero from null; respect rate and quota errors.
